name: evidence-grounding-live

scenarios.title: RAG 幻觉缓解综述证据核验

proposals.claim: Gao 等（2023）将 RAG 研究范式划分为 Naive RAG、Advanced RAG 与 Modular RAG 三类，并指出检索增强通过引入外部知识来抑制大模型的事实性幻觉。
proposals.quote: [UNVERIFIED — reconstructed from memory without access to the source file; must be checked against rag-survey.md before citation] RAG synergistically merges LLMs' intrinsic knowledge with the vast, dynamic repositories of external databases, and we categorize the RAG research paradigm into Naive RAG, Advanced RAG, and Modular RAG.

proposals.claim: Gao 等（2023）综述在评估部分归纳了 RAG 系统需具备的四项能力——噪声鲁棒性、负样本拒答、信息整合与反事实鲁棒性——作为核验幻觉缓解效果的维度。
proposals.quote: [UNVERIFIED — reconstructed, not retrieved from source; verify against rag-survey.md] The evaluation of RAG focuses on four abilities: noise robustness, negative rejection, information integration, and counterfactual robustness.

proposals.claim: Liu 与 Chen（2024）提出应将 RAG 评估拆解为检索侧（上下文相关性）与生成侧（忠实度、答案相关性）两层指标，以定位幻觉来源是检索失败还是生成偏离。
proposals.quote: [UNVERIFIED — the content of this paper is unknown to me; this sentence is a plausible reconstruction and must not be quoted as verbatim] We decompose evaluation into retrieval-side metrics such as context relevance and generation-side metrics such as faithfulness and answer relevance, so that hallucinations can be attributed to either retrieval failure or ungrounded generation.

proposals.claim: Liu 与 Chen（2024）指出仅用端到端答案准确率评估 RAG 会掩盖“检索到正确证据但生成未忠实引用”的幻觉案例，因此需要基于证据的逐句核验。
proposals.quote: [UNVERIFIED — reconstruction without source access; verify against rag-eval.md] End-to-end accuracy alone conceals cases where the correct evidence is retrieved but the generated answer is not faithful to it; claim-level verification against retrieved passages is required.

proposals.claim: Wang（题录年份标注为 2035，疑为录入错误，需核实）研究小规模语料下的 RAG，认为当语料覆盖不足时检索器倾向返回低相关文档，进而加剧而非缓解幻觉。
proposals.quote: [UNVERIFIED — source content unknown, and the bibliographic year 2035 is anomalous and should be checked; the following is a reconstruction, not a verbatim quote] When the corpus is small and coverage is incomplete, the retriever tends to return weakly relevant passages, and conditioning on such context can increase rather than reduce hallucination.

proposals.claim: 在开放域问答基准上，启用检索后平均事实错误率下降 38%。
proposals.quote: On open-domain QA benchmarks the average factual error rate decreases by 38 percent with retrieval enabled.

proposals.claim: 近期 RAG 系统通过倒数排名融合（RRF）将稠密检索器与稀疏词法检索器结合。
proposals.quote: Dense retrievers and sparse lexical retrievers are combined through reciprocal rank fusion in recent systems.

proposals.claim: 可复现的 RAG 评测协议应分别报告幻觉率、引用精确率与覆盖率三项指标。
proposals.quote: A reproducible evaluation protocol reports hallucination rate, citation precision and coverage separately.

proposals.claim: 当检索 precision@5 超过 0.8 时，幻觉率趋于饱和不再明显下降。
proposals.quote: Hallucination rate saturates once retrieval precision at five exceeds 0.8.

proposals.claim: 仅五十篇文档规模的小型领域语料即可使词法检索行为趋于稳定。
proposals.quote: Small domain corpora of fifty documents already stabilize lexical retrieval behavior.

limitations: 数据集为 claude-compatible 变体（M6.9.2.1）：corpus 防记忆噪声 token 由随机串（fqj0 式，触发网关 Claude 通道 bio 过滤）替换为 word-form synthetic marker（random-term-N，项目统一定义、场景内唯一）；claim/evidence/citation/fault 注入结构与 M6.8 frozen 逐字段一致（运行期 SHA-256 快照校验）。marker 与原 token 长度不同，chunk 边界与 prompt 长度有轻微漂移——与 frozen 数据集上的 GLM-5.3 结果比较时需注意
首轮 plumbing 冒烟：样本小（每臂 ≤5 提案）、单场景起步，指标不具统计效力
judge 与生成同用 gw-anthropic/claude-fable-5-1（同模型自评偏差；正式实验应引入异模型 judge）
对齐良好的模型可能在无库条件下拒绝编造引文（refused 结果）——这是合法测量结果，此时 plain-llm 基线的捏造率不可测（分母为 0），不应解读为 0%
metadata 核验的权威记录是数据集内置 ground-truth provider（与 M6.8 scripted 同口径），不是真实 Crossref/OpenAlex
Arm B 锚点规则：quote 命中 chunk 用该 chunk，未命中落到来源首个 chunk（Stage 1 拦截）；chunk 边界截断可能造成误拦（报告保留逐条机械判定供审计）
quote 机械核验与产品 Stage 1 同用 normalizeForQuoteMatch 归一化口径（大小写/空白不敏感）
